summary: The init container's prune keeps a superset of the branches Gitblit v1.10.0 indexes (checked against LuceneService.updateIndex and JGitUtils.getDefaultBranch), leaves a conf with nothing stale untouched, and runs the same file the test exercises. The test caught 10 of 11 mutations, and it passes under the official busybox:latest binary as well as the sidecar's.
